title: On a slow line, Add 10 or a new product can be saved twice
what: The admin app gives up waiting after 15 seconds and says the internet is down, but the gym server may still finish the change. Add 10 adds to whatever stock is there, so a second press after that message adds 20 in total. Saving a new product the same way can make two copies of it, and the form does not re-read the list first. Sending a message is safer: it re-reads the sent list after a failure, but still lets the same words be sent again.
expected: A press that is repeated after a lost answer finds the first one and does not change stock or add a product twice.
how_often: on a slow or dropping line
fix_line: Send a one-time number with Add 10, new product and message sends so a repeat finds the first

title: Shop and member-app screens say 'Something went wrong' and nobody at MettleUp hears of it
what: When the gym server turns a shop, order, product or message change away for a reason the app does not know, the owner sees 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' The real reason is not kept anywhere, not even in the browser's own log. Other failures on these screens are written only to that browser's log. Crash reports reach MettleUp only for errors nothing caught, so all of these stay unseen until a gym complains.
expected: Every 'try again' keeps the real reason and sends a short report MettleUp can read, so a broken shop is seen before a gym calls.
fix_line: Send caught shop and message failures to the same crash report with the real reason

title: MettleUp counts shop orders and app members, but not messages, offers or shop money
what: HQ shows each gym's app members and orders in the last 30 days. It does not count messages sent to members, workout offers, invite or join-online use, or how much the shop sells. Decisions about which member-app tools gyms value, and whether the shop earns enough to keep, are made blind.
expected: HQ shows, per gym and in total, messages sent, offers given, joins from the invite link and shop money, over the last 30 days.
fix_line: Add these counts to the HQ gym row

items.reason: a web admin page: no heart rate, rest timer, workout clock or watch; its order polling pauses when hidden and catches up on show by design (ShopProvider.tsx:8)
